text:
ops-bot: :rotating_light: Alert — asia2 GPU-pool-7 reporting rapid OOM evictions (85% burst), elevated GPU queue latency. Services impacted: gen-api, embedder-2. Automatic fallback to dedicated pools scheduled in 60s unless acknowledged.

maria: acknowledging. I'm looking at pool-7 logs now, starting a quick evict-scan.

devon: on it, will grab the oncall handoff. can someone run a light traffic tilt to eu-west while we triage?

liam: +1, recommend 25% tilt to eu-west3 for 10m, then reassess. I can push the route.

jen: note — asia2 has a recent kernel driver bump; we've seen slightly higher memory accounting. might be related.

maria: confirmed pattern: OOMs spike when seq_len > 1024 and batch size > 8. embedder-2 is hitting long sequences from a customer test.

devon: plan: (1) immediate partial traffic tilt, (2) throttle long-seq requests via edge policy, (3) restart problematic worker set on pool-7, (4) if still unstable, failover gen-api to dedicated-gpu-3.

liam: executing tilt now: `shift-traffic --from asia2 --to eu-west3 --percent 25 --duration 10m`

ops-bot: shift-traffic command accepted. Starting gradual ramp over 30s.

maria: while tilt ramps, I'll run an eviction snapshot:```
kubectl -n inference logs deploy/pool-7-eviction-proxy --since=15m | jq '.events | select(.type=="OOMKill")'
```

jen: adding a quick temporary rule to edge config to reject sequences > 1200 with 429, to protect pool-7. Deploying now.

devon: i'm doing a rolling restart of worker nodes tagged pool-7-heavy, one at a time. keeping drain timeout short.

liam: tilt is live, traffic now 25% to eu-west3. latency for gen-api slightly up in eu-west3 but within SLOs.

maria: eviction snapshot shows 18 OOM events from embedder-2 over last 10m, all from the same job-id prefix job/rt-test-*. I'll contact customer success to pause their test.

sre-lead: good mitigation. two quick policy tweaks we should persist after incident: (a) auto-throttle for long-seq experimental jobs, (b) alert threshold lowered to 70% evictions for gpu-pools. filing followups.

devon: one worker restart completed, memory usage dropped ~30% on that node. continuing.

ops-bot: automatic fallback did not trigger because oncall acknowledged. Fallback window remains open for 20m.

liam: can ops-bot add annotation to the incident tracker: `oom-spillboard` with affected pool and job prefix.

ops-bot: annotation added: tag=oom-spillboard pool=asia2/pool-7 jobs=job/rt-test-*

maria: customer test paused by CS. embedder-2 traffic dropped ~60%, OOMs stabilizing.

devon: all restarts done. pool steady with one anomalous host that I cordoned, will reprovision later.

jen: reverting edge rule (accept long seqs) only after we confirm post-mitigation. hold for 30m.

liam: tilt running out in ~4m; we should decide whether to keep partial tilt for a longer cooldown or shift back fully. leaning to keep 10-15% tilt for 20m to avoid immediate re-burst.

maria: agree. keep 15% for 20m then evaluate. I'll watch eviction metric.

sre-lead: great work. post-incident action items: write playbook steps for oom-spillboard scenario, add metric dashboards, add runbook for cordon/reprovision pattern, and schedule postmortem if evictions reappear.

liam: setting tilt to 15% now: `shift-traffic --from asia2 --to eu-west3 --percent 15 --duration 20m --reason "oom-spillboard cooldown"`

ops-bot: tilt updated.

maria: eviction rate fell to baseline. I'm going to mark incident as mitigated but will keep monitoring and hand off to day-shift for follow-up.

devon: oncall handoff in 45m — tagging @jen for daytime follow-up.

jen: acknowledged. i'll take follow-up and track the post-incident actions. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
